description: FNPF 2D regular waves of fnpf_2d_regular (RK3) with the start values of the stage solves of the Laplace equation extrapolated in time (A 431 1): from the solutions at t^n and t^n-1 for the first stage, from the solution of the stage before and that at t^n for the other two. The solution is that of fnpf_2d_regular within the tolerance of the solves (N 44).
